title: Container Gardening: Growing Broccoli and Calendula
reason: The video describes the process of setting up container gardening, including soil preparation and plant transplantation.

tasks.task: Describe the process of preparing containers for plants.

subtasks.text: Note the use of different soil mixes and containers for planting calendula.
Observe the step of leveling the soil inside the containers.

tasks.task: Demonstrate transplanting a plant into a container and covering the roots.

subtasks.text: Watch the process of planting calendula into the container at its original depth.
See the placement of fertilizer on top of the soil before planting.

tasks.task: Explain the choice of container size for different plants.

subtasks.text: Observe the reason for using large containers for broccoli.
Note the choice of smaller containers for calendula due to their smaller root system.

tasks.task: Showcase the watering technique for the containers.

subtasks.text: See the use of a dram nozzle to water the containers in a thorough manner.
Observe the demonstration of running water out through the bottom of the container.

tasks.task: Highlight the benefits of container gardening.

subtasks.text: Note the advantage of moving plants inside during cold weather.
